heroDesc: Join Sri Lanka's largest network of verified healthcare professionals. We handle the finding clients, insurance, and billing. You just focus on caring.

whyChoose.desc: We are building the first "Nurse-First" ecosystem in Sri Lanka. We believe that if we take care of you, you will take better care of our patients.

benefits.title: Impactful Earnings
benefits.desc: Earn above market rates with our transparent payment structure. Weekly payouts directly to your bank account.

benefits.title: Flexible Schedule
benefits.desc: You are your own boss. Accept shifts that fit your life—whether it's night shifts, weekends, or full-time live-in.

benefits.title: Career Growth
benefits.desc: Access free training modules, certification upgrades, and mentorship from senior matrons.

steps.title: Submit Documents
steps.desc: Upload NIC, Certificates, and CV via our app.

steps.title: Skill Assessment
steps.desc: Take a quick online quiz or visit our center for practicals.

steps.title: Background Check
steps.desc: We verify your police report and past employment.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.desc: Receive your uniform, ID, and VCare App access.
